trustBoundary: Reference deployment only. The security model requires the integrator to audit, vet and deploy their own copy of the adapter under their own name; this row exists so an integrator can diff their deployment against Cork's reference.
notices: Review level is unreviewed and stage is partner-preview: no production support commitment attaches to this component version.
Deployed via CREATE2 through the deterministic deployment factory: the address is a function of salt and init code, not of the chain.
Bound at deployment: the phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1 pool manager and whitelist manager, and the 1inch Limit Order Protocol v4. The adapter binds no market-registry address.

CorkForSelfAdapter.description: Receiver-forcing adapter: pool actions plus fillOrderForSelf, no receiver parameter anywhere, approvals to the adapter only — proceeds can only land on the caller.
